table: Table 12. Definition of the quality control flags
note: FIVE SEPARATE FLAG SCALES. The same integer means different things in each. Do not mix them in one column.

entire_cast.applies_to: whole cast, as a function of variable

flags.2: two or more density inversions (Levitus, 1982 criteria)
flags.6: failed annual and seasonal standard deviation check
flags.7: bullseye from standard level data or failed annual and monthly standard deviation check
flags.8: failed seasonal and monthly standard deviation check
flags.9: failed annual, seasonal and monthly standard deviation check

flags.1: duplicates or inversions in recorded depth (same or less than previous depth)

observed_level.applies_to: individual variable observations at observed levels

flags.1: range outlier (outside of broad range check)
flags.4: observed level 'bullseye' flag and zero gradient check
flags.8: failed range and questionable data checks
flags.9: failed range and combined gradient and inversion checks

standard_level.applies_to: values interpolated to standard depth levels

flags.6: failed annual and seasonal standard deviation check
flags.7: failed annual and monthly standard deviation check
flags.8: failed seasonal and monthly standard deviation check
flags.9: failed annual, seasonal and monthly standard deviation check

biological.applies_to: Comparable Biological Value (CBV), Taxa code 27 only

flags.1: range outlier (outside of broad range check)
